args.text: Hi June, I need your approval on something. Tobias Rendle asked me to draft a mail (he'll send it himself) to Pree Sundaram with the Tansleigh Packaging proposed 2027 per-seat rate for the pricing review. The figure comes from his call with the customer yesterday. Pree isn't the account owner, CFO or deal desk, so under the finance-figures rule I need an OK from you or Anselm before a per-seat rate goes to her. Is it OK for me to prepare that draft?

Hi Tobias, I haven't saved the draft yet. A per-seat rate counts as a finance figure, and those can only go to Anselm, June or the account owner. Pree is none of those, so anything sending her the rate needs Anselm or June to approve it first, even if you own the account. I've asked June by DM and logged an approval request. I left the figure out of my note to her.

Once she (or Anselm) says yes, I'll save the draft in your mailbox: to Pree (psundaram@pemberline.com), subject "Tansleigh 2027 rate", with the $1,805/seat proposed 2027 rate from your call yesterday. If you'd like Anselm asked as well, just say.
